subject: Post-call recap & proposal: 3-way rotating demo cadence
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Wong <alex.wong@mediwell.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & proposal: 3-way rotating demo cadence

Hi Alex — great call today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock a technical deep dive. TL;DR: propose a short, rotating weekly cadence so we cover US/EU/APAC stakeholders without repeatedly asking the same engineers to join outside their core hours.

Recap (2 min):
- Primary use case: low-latency LLM inference for clinical summarization and chart ingestion.
- Decision criteria: latency under 200ms for typical requests, SOC2 evidence, predictable unit costs.
- Timeline: procurement/PO expected ~by end of July; technical validation needs to happen this month.

Proposal: 3-week rotating baton of demo windows (keeps the same 3 slots but rotates which region is prioritized each week). This reduces repeated night calls for any single team and gets your clinical, infra, and security folks on a regular cadence.

Suggested slots (local-friendly anchors — times shown in UTC):
- Slot A (US-favorable): 15:00 UTC (US morning / EU afternoon)
- Slot B (EU-favorable): 08:00 UTC (EU morning / US early)
- Slot C (APAC-favorable): 00:00 UTC (APAC morning / US late)

How the rotation works: Week 1 = Slot A primary (invite goes to US engineering + EU clinical), Week 2 = Slot B primary (invite to EU infra + US PMs), Week 3 = Slot C primary (invite to APAC clinical + EU observers), then repeat. The technical deep dive itself will be a 60-minute session with a 30-minute demo + 30-minute Q&A/PoC planning.

Next steps / asks:
- Can you confirm which stakeholders should be invited to the technical deep dive (clinical, infra, security)?
- Which of the three slot anchors above best maps to your team preferences? If helpful, we can propose two calendar slots for the first cycle (Week 1 and Week 2) and rotate automatically thereafter.

Attachments: proposed_rotating_time_slots.xlsx (xlsx) — simple matrix with local times for each office. Also attaching my quick discovery notes: discovery-notes.pdf.

If that approach works, I’ll send calendar invites for the Week 1 slot and include a short meeting agenda and runbook.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0142

--
Redwood Inference — production-first inference for LLMs
From: Alex Wong <alex.wong@mediwell.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Simon Park <simon.park@mediwell.io>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 09:03:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & proposal: 3-way rotating demo cadence

Vivek — thanks, this is helpful. Quick answers:
- Stakeholders: myself (clinical), Simon Park (platform lead), and our security lead (I copied Simon; security will be looped in once we see the SOC2 docs). We will probably bring one data engineer + one clinical SME to the deep dive.
- Preferred slots: Slot A or Slot B works best for us — we prefer not to do the 00:00 UTC slot if we can avoid it.
- Timing constraints: we have a standing leadership review on Wednesdays between 08:30–09:30 CEST, so avoid that window.

I can do Slot A on Tue/Wed mornings (CEST) and Slot B on Thursday mornings. If you can send proposed calendar times (with time zone conversions) that would be ideal.

One more thing: procurement asked if we can get an estimated token-cost example for a 1M request/month baseline — we can discuss in the deep dive, but a quick number would help keep momentum.

Subject: Re: Post-call recap & proposal: 3-way rotating demo cadence

Adding a bit more color from the solutions side — thanks for the clear guidance, Alex. A couple operational clarifications so the session is productive:

- Suggested attendee list from Redwood for the first two sessions: Ben Carter (Solutions Engineer), Neha Kapoor (Customer Success / onboarding), Vivek (AE). If you want deeper infra detail we can add one of our runtime engineers.
- Format: 30m technical demo (focus on inference pipeline, latency tradeoffs, and quantization options) + 30m workshop to map your sample flows to a PoC plan.

Concrete rotation example (explicit dates/times for clarity):
- Week 1 (primary = Slot A): Tue 2025-06-24 15:00 UTC (08:00 PT / 11:00 ET / 17:00 CEST) — invite clinical and US PMs
- Week 2 (primary = Slot B): Thu 2025-07-02 08:00 UTC (01:00 PT / 04:00 ET / 10:00 CEST) — invite EU infra + observers from US
- Week 3 (primary = Slot C): Tue 2025-07-08 00:00 UTC (17:00 PT prev day / 20:00 ET prev day / 02:00 CEST) — invite APAC clinical (we'll avoid if you prefer)

We can skip Week 3 (Slot C) entirely for the initial validation cycle if you prefer not to work overnight — we just wanted to offer a way to get APAC engineers involved without indefinite late calls for the same people.

Attachment: I updated the spreadsheet with local time conversions and a suggested invite cadence. File: proposed_rotating_time_slots.xlsx (xlsx).

Let us know whether Tue 2025-06-24 15:00 UTC (Week 1 / Slot A) works for you; if so Vivek will send the calendar invite and we’ll include a short meeting agenda.

Thanks,
Ben
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 01:20:00 +08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & proposal: 3-way rotating demo cadence

Alex / team — thanks for the quick replies and the preference guidance. Good call on avoiding the midnight slot for now — we’ll keep APAC observers optional for this initial validation.

Confirmed next step: Tue 2025-06-24 15:00 UTC (Week 1 / Slot A) — I’ll send a calendar invite with the agenda and dial-in + Miro board link. Invite will include: you (Alex), Simon (platform), one clinical SME, Ben, Neha, and myself.

On the procurement token-cost ask: I attached a short example in discovery-notes.pdf that maps an assumed request shape to an estimated monthly unit cost for 1M requests — we’ll walk through that in the deep dive and refine once we see a representative payload.

If anything changes to attendees or if Simon wants a different weekday, flag it and we’ll adjust. Otherwise expect the invite in the next hour.

Cheers,
Vivek
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai
